notes.title: v1.2.8 Released!
notes.notes:
We have updated the game to use an updated version of the engine we're using which should fix the font errors. In addition, we now support Simplified Chinese! Of course, more insane quests have been added.

Sorry for the font issue with the last version. We'll try to stay on top of issues.

notes.title: v1.2.5 Released!
notes.notes:
Sorry for the delay everyone, we had to wait for our engine provider to fix a bug with the font rendering. Gunman Taco Truck now looks normal again!

Thank you for sticking it out with us.

notes.title: v1.2.4 Released
notes.notes: We had some reports of stuttering and incompatibilities that coincided with a certain version of the engine we're using. We've updated the game with a stable version of the engine so those issues should be gone. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: v1.2.3 UPDATE RELEASED!
notes.notes: We have finally fixed the black screen of death bug that some of you have been getting. So sorry to have taken so long. We fixed a bunch of other small stuff you probably wouldn't notice. But the black screen bug – oh, that was noticed.

notes.title: v1.2 RELEASED!
notes.notes: After months of taunting and torturing you about the v1.2 Cop Update – it is finally released. We wrapped up our bug fixes, smuggling dialogue and gib physics – and the result is hilarious! Now, in addition to shooting mutants and making tacos you can also smuggle packages and people across state lines. Get caught and it becomes a highway to hell with your taco truck pitted against an insane mutant cop!

notes.title: New v1.1.3 Release
notes.notes:
We just released v1.1.3 on Steam. It contains bugfixes for some issues that were introduced in yesterday's v1.1.2; issues that we are very sorry were bothering your hard-earned Taco Trucks.

One important change we made is to ease up on the difficulty in both Easy and Normal mode. When you leave a city in Easy mode, one customer will die each time you leave. In Normal mode, all customers EXCEPT ONE will die. This allows you to return to cities and still have customers if you haven't run them all off by refusing service.

There are also some new Shop and Garage names. They're spectacular.

We are still working on the really cool, big update that has police in it. It's looking really great and we're making quick progress of it.

We are also working on improving the early game to make it more exciting and have some more variety. We love it the way it's balanced, but we can do better.

notes.title: Romero family s Gunman Taco Truck out, designed by 9-year-old
notes.notes: I had heard that Brenda Romero was working on a new, serious game which in part explored the relationship between Mexican culture and food, but Gunman Taco Truck [official site] wasn’t what I was expecting… Oh, wait, this isn’t that? This action game about blasting your way across post-apocalypse United States and selling tacos to the survivors was actually designed by a nine-year-old Donovan Brathwaite-Romero and co-developed by him with his mum Brenda and stepdad John Romero. It’s now out on Steam and there’s a trailer below. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: New version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
We just pushed an update to Gunman Taco Truck with the main fix being a font issue with Windows 7 computers. While doing this, we fixed a number of other issues. Here's our changelog:

    New font
    Options now save when the game exits from the options menu
    Escape no longer cancels orders in the taco builder
    Fixed the location of the buy gas button
    Added support for the escape key on desktop devices
    New Town FTUE step
    Strings now default to english if the string indexed is empty
    Localization of controls screen + “miles” on road signs
    Worldmap widescreen error fixed
    Weapon speedup on full-auto mode
    Updated strings_template.lua
    Fixed an issue with saving screenshots on Desktop
    Fixed an issue with mobile detection in the options
    Fixed a bug with achievement reporting on steam
    Improved performance of the cipher function
    Added new flurry hooks
    Added support for steamworks
    Added controls page to the options screen
    Fixed a bug where ingredients could get stuck beneath the taco
    Ingredients now clean up after you fold the taco
    Increased the amount of points you get for kills on hard
    Fixed a bug where certain projectiles could leak

The new build should be live on Steam shortly.

notes.title: Taco Tuesday Launch!
notes.notes:
We are very excited for the official launch of Gunman Taco Truck on TACO TUESDAY, January 31, 2017. We hope you grab Gunman and have a mutant-blasting time trying to make your way across the shattered United States up to the safe haven of Winnipeg, Canada.

We are going to release a Donovan interview and have some giveaways, so follow @gunmantacotruck for announcements as well as this group.

Please leave comments and tell us what you think about Gunman Taco Truck! If we get enough requests for game improvements we will consider all good feedback. We already have some plans for some great additions.
